inj.note: McCormick dislocated his ankle during the Steelers' 38-18 loss to the Bengals on Sunday. The good news for the third-year pro is that he avoided a fracture and does not require surgery, so there's a chance he could return for the Steelers should the team qualify for the playoffs, per reporters. Brock Hoffman figures to start at left guard in McCormick's stead.
